Marcus, the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is Thea Ramaswell, their Director of Yard Operations. I've posted that in a thread on your message in #north-team.

Back in August 2025, Dana said in #north-team that Thea had reported the duplicate arrivals on door 6 again, on the morning shift. Dana said she'd look into it herself, so she's the one to ask about where it stands. The North cheat sheet also lists Thea as the main contact for the account.
